original.target_description: Table 2 self-report correlations of BFI Agreeableness with Heartland Forgiveness Scale Self, Other, Situation, and Total scores. The neutral locator does not specify which forgiveness score is intended; correspondence remains unresolved.

n.sample_role: Participant-level correlations; 140 is the reported overall participant sample, not an explicitly documented analytic N for the target correlation.
n.exclusions: No target-test exclusions, missingness handling, or pairwise analytic sample count stated in the supplied Method/Results and Table 2.
n.location: Method: Participants and Procedure; Results: Table 2
n.quote: Participants were 140 undergraduate students enrolled in introductory psychology courses at a large, public university.

notes: Identity independently verified: supplied canonical text is the PMC full-text author manuscript of Gratitude and forgiveness: Convergence and divergence on self-report and informant ratings, by William E Breen, Todd B Kashdan, Monica L Lenser, and Frank D Fincham; final publication Pers Individ Dif. 2010 Dec 1;49(8):932–937; DOI 10.1016/j.paid.2010.07.033. Contains Method, Results, tables, Discussion and references, rather than an abstract-only excerpt. No PDF supplied. Assigned fields only: n_o and pval_value_o. The Table 2 locator establishes zero-order self-report correlations, but does not distinguish the HFS subscales from the HFS total. Printed candidates in the explicitly labelled HFS column sequence are Self r=.43**, Other r=.49**, Situation r=.42**, Total r=.58**; each ** has printed p < .01. These are candidates only: no particular HFS score was selected. The printed Z=−3.11 and adjacent p<.01 test the difference between dependent correlations, not the forgiveness–agreeableness correlation; that adjacent p was not substituted. Overall participant count 140 and returned confidant packets 137 of 140 are separate roles. Neither is explicitly stated as the analytic N for the assigned self-report test; no N inferred from recruitment, sex-group sums, or degrees of freedom. No arithmetic derivation performed. Replication, effect-size, and success fields are unassigned placeholders.
